patch_description:
The prior approach uses seven greedy orderings and up to 40 local-search iterations per ordering. Its key parameters are the ordering set, best-fit mode, and local-improvement iteration limit.

This version directly searches for a low KVPR bound using transformed bin packing. For a proposed pressure bound `P`, each model has transformed weight `load + P * model_size` and every GPU has capacity `P * 80`. A packing within this capacity guarantees both memory feasibility and KVPR at most `P`. The algorithm performs 24 adaptive binary-search rounds over this threshold, evaluates four transformed packing orders at every feasible threshold, retains the best actual KVPR placement, and then applies 60 lexicographic local-improvement steps. Lexicographic pressure comparison improves not only the worst GPU pressure but also secondary GPU pressures when the maximum is tied.
